1) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine of __greater than 600 Da and less than 2000 Da__ and a polyanion, said nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron.

2) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle intimately associated with a __different multivalent cation crosslinker__.

3) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyalkylenimine is __a polyalkylenimine selected from polyethylenimine or polypropylenimine__.

4) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyanion is selected from sodium polyvinyl sulfonate, poly (sodium acrylate), poly(sodium styrene sulfonate), copolymers of sodium acrylate with sodium vinylsulfonate or sodium styrene sulfonate; dextran sulfate, and __other anionic polymers__.

5) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 2, wherein said multivalent cation crosslinker is a complexed zirconium compound selected from the group consisting of zirconium acetate, sodium zirconium lactate, zirconium sulfate, zirconium tetrachloride, zirconium orthosulfate, zirconium oxychloride, zirconium carbonate, zirconium ammonium carbonate, zirconium acetylacetonate, aluminum chloride, aluminum sulfate, aluminum citrate, tin chloride, tin sulfate, iron chloride, iron nitrate, titanium chloride, and titanium sulfate, __wherein the concentration of said crosslinker is optimized for the nanoparticle size__.

6) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, further comprising monovalent or divalent cations selected from the group consisting of sodium, potassium, magnesium or calcium ions, __wherein the concentration of said cations is controlled to enhance stability__.

8) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex __is characterized by an average particle size of about 100 to 900 nm in diameter__.

12) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 10, said nanoparticle entrapping a multivalent cation __selected from zirconium, chromium, titanium, iron, or aluminum__.

13) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 12, said multivalent cation comprising __at least one of Zr, Cr, Ti, Fe or Al in a concentration effective for crosslinking__. 

21) (Currently Amended) A delayed gelling composition comprising: a) a composition of claim 1; b) a polymer __that is capable of being crosslinked with a multivalent cation__; and c) a fluid.

24) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is a polymer or copolymers of acrylate, acrylamide, N,N-dimethyacrylamide, tert-butyl acrylate, acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonic acid, or sodium 2-acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonate, or N,N-dimethylacrylamide.
